name: Dubai Luxury Tour
summary: Six days of Dubai at full polish: a sunset slot at the top of the world's tallest building, a private-feeling desert evening of dunes and starlit BBQ, marina dinner cruises and Palm views — with one morning kept aside for the old city's gold and spice souks, reached the proper way, by one-dirham abra.
highlights: Burj Khalifa At the Top at sunset, fountain show after
Evening desert safari with BBQ camp dinner
Old Dubai souk morning and Palm Jumeirah day

itinerary.title: Arrive & the Marina
itinerary.description: Airport pickup, check-in, first-night dinner cruise through the Dubai Marina skyline.

itinerary.title: Downtown Dubai
itinerary.description: Dubai Mall and its aquarium, sunset at the Burj Khalifa observation decks, and the fountain show from the promenade.

itinerary.title: Desert evening
itinerary.description: Free morning by the pool or beach, afternoon pickup for dune bashing, a camel ride at sunset, and BBQ dinner with live shows at a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Old Dubai & new icons
itinerary.description: Abra across the creek to the Gold and Spice Souks, Al Fahidi heritage lanes, then the Dubai Frame and Museum of the Future.

itinerary.title: The Palm & the beach
itinerary.description: Palm Jumeirah monorail and The View, lazy beach afternoon at JBR with the skyline behind.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Last-minute mall run or beach breakfast, airport drop.
